div.p: Lewiston Elks Lodge #896 · 3444 Country Club Drive, Lewiston, Idaho 83501
div.div: Please note: These Terms & Conditions are subject to change from time to time, without prior notice. The terms in effect on the date your agreement is signed will govern your event.
div.p: Thank you for allowing Lewiston Elks Lodge #896 to help you with your special event. Our facilities include the Riverview Room, Seaport Room, Lodge Room, Dining Area, VIP Area, Green Room, Lounge/Bar Area, and Parking Area.

ol.li: The Lewiston Elks Lodge #896 has total authority to oversee and maintain order of the event. Guests and Elk members shall always conduct themselves in a courteous manner. Use of the Lodge or premises is at your own risk. All local, state, and federal laws are to be adhered to.

No alcoholic beverages are to be brought onto the premises at any time (this is an Idaho state law, and includes the Lodge building, patio, and parking lot). All beverages are to be purchased from the Lounge Bar.
Wine may be brought in as stated and governed by Lewiston Lodge #896 Bylaws. A corkage fee will be assessed for wine brought in to be served at the event.
A Certificate of Liability Insurance must be on file prior to the date of the event.
All Elk members have access to the Lodge during normal Lodge business hours.
All damage to the building or premises will be billed at the full replacement cost.
The use of rice, seeds, sparklers, confetti, glitter, or foreign materials is strictly prohibited.
No animals are permitted on the premises.
The Elks are not responsible for lost or unclaimed property.
Any changes to the contract must be made in writing no less than 14 days prior to the event.
Premises are to be left in the same condition at the end of the event as at the beginning.
The event must be finished by 12:00 A.M. (no exceptions).
Recommended capacity by room of the facility must not be exceeded.
Failure to abide by the terms of this agreement will terminate the event and all guests will be asked to leave.

ul.li: Kitchen facilities are not available to parties and/or caterers. The refrigerator and countertops may be used for serving with prior approval.
Only approved caterers are allowed entry to the facility for events. Caterer license and insurance must be on file with the Elks Lodge (no exceptions).
Competitive and discount pricing is available when using our in-house caterer on parties of 100 or more guests.
The Lodge is released of any responsibility for any food brought onto the premises.
A non-refundable cleaning fee of $100.00 will be charged; all cleaning fees are due and payable at the time of signing.
50% of all other fees are due at signing, with the remaining balance due the day prior to the scheduled event.
Cancellation of the event within seven (7) days will forfeit 100% of the reservation fees.

Garbage must be removed from the facility. Garbage removal and disposal for events with over 50 guests are the responsibility of the renter. A $75 garbage overage removal fee will be charged for use of the Lodge dumpster.
An extra bartender fee applies for parties of over 100 guests ($150.00).

Rental fees are based on a one-day event. Any additional time for setup and takedown will be assessed an additional 25% rental fee for each day — a "day" being all or part of the hours between 12:00 P.M. and 6:00 P.M. the day before the event, or all or part of the hours between 9:00 A.M. and 12:00 P.M. the day after the event. Any time exceeding these windows will be charged at $100 per hour.
Departed members in good standing may use the facility for Celebration of Life and/or memorial services as stated in the Bylaws of Lewiston Elks Lodge #896.

div.p: The Renter agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Lewiston Elks Lodge #896, its officers, members, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees) arising out of or in connection with the Renter's use of the facility, including but not limited to any accident, injury, damage, or loss occurring on the premises during the term of this Agreement.
